title: Create an empty tuple
description:
Create an empty tuple.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as create_empty_tuple(), returning an empty tuple.
hints: A tuple is written with parentheses containing comma-separated values, but an empty one needs no commas at all.
This is different from an empty function call or an empty list - the empty tuple has its own literal form.
Return () - two parentheses with nothing between them - to produce the empty tuple.
explanation: () is the literal for an empty tuple, just as [] is the literal for an empty list - no elements means no commas are needed inside the parentheses.
